limitations: The comparison is limited to one reference annual period per issuer and to the concepts whose XBRL tags are unambiguous in this fixture.
Total debt is compared as the sum of the raw debt tags present; a filer that reports debt only inside a combined line is not independently reconstructable.
Amendments are resolved by filing date in this audit; that is a policy choice, not an assertion that every restatement is economically correct.
No market prices exist in this fixture, so market-implied valuation and any price-based share-count cross-check are unavailable.

market_prices.note: The compact real-company fixture bundles no market prices.

method: Raw SEC companyfacts JSON is re-parsed with independent fiscal-period and tag-priority logic and compared with Atlas evidence at the issuer's reference annual period. Amendments win by filing date, not by database insertion order.

readiness.reason: SIC 6211 identifies a bank, insurer, broker or other financial institution. An unlevered free-cash-flow-to-firm DCF is not an economically valid model here: debt and deposits are operating inputs, interest expense is an operating cost, and free cash flow to the firm is not defined the way it is for a non-financial operating company. Atlas does not substitute an equity DCF, dividend discount model or residual income model because none of those is implemented and independently validated in this release.
